backlog.title: Implement candidate-bound 11-surface visual regression harness
backlog.evidence: Current .github/workflows/ui-snapshot.yml triggers pushes only on legacy agent/pathena, runs Ubuntu/offscreen, and uploads one pathena-ui.png. scripts/render_pathena_ui_snapshot.py captures one 1480x900 window after 750 ms with no canonical state enumeration, baseline mapping or comparator. Existing exact Windows diagnostics render 11 surfaces but only prove renderability/upload, not objective visual equivalence.
acceptance_criteria: canonical capture enumerates exactly 11 named surfaces/states deterministically
workflow targets current candidate/explicit dispatch rather than legacy agent/pathena only
baseline set is versioned and updates require explicit review
comparison tolerates bounded antialiasing noise but fails meaningful geometry/color/content drift
missing or extra surface fails closed
failure uploads actual/baseline/diff per failing surface
harness does not make network calls or mutate user data
verification_plan: exact Windows run for capture/comparison because font and Qt rendering are platform-sensitive
full Windows not automatically required unless product/runtime paths change
